SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_id) AS total_categories,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN comp.component_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.category_id END) AS active_categories,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN comp.component_id IS NULL THEN c.category_id END) AS empty_categories,
  COALESCE(SUM(comp_count.component_count), 0) AS total_components,
  COALESCE(SUM(new_items.new_count), 0) AS recent_additions,
  COALESCE(MAX(latest.latest_added_date), NOW()) AS latest_component_date,
  COALESCE(MIN(oldest.oldest_added_date), NOW()) AS oldest_component_date,
  ROUND(AVG(cat_sizes.category_size)::numeric, 2) AS avg_category_size,
  MAX(cat_sizes.category_size) AS largest_category_size,
  (SELECT category_name FROM categories c2 LEFT JOIN (SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS cat_size FROM components GROUP BY category_id) s ON c2.category_id = s.category_id WHERE s.cat_size = (SELECT MAX(cat_size) FROM (SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS cat_size FROM components GROUP BY category_id) x) LIMIT 1) AS largest_category_name
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN components comp ON c.category_id = comp.category_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS component_count
  FROM components
  GROUP BY category_id
) comp_count ON comp_count.category_id = c.category_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS new_count
  FROM components
  WHERE date_added >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
  GROUP BY category_id
) new_items ON new_items.category_id = c.category_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT MAX(date_added) AS latest_added_date
  FROM components
) latest ON true
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT MIN(date_added) AS oldest_added_date
  FROM components
) oldest ON true
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS category_size
  FROM components
  GROUP BY category_id
) cat_sizes ON cat_sizes.category_id = c.category_id;

WITH filtered_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_id,
        c.category_name,
        COUNT(comp.component_id) as component_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN comp.date_added >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 END) as recent_additions,
        MIN(comp.date_added) as first_component_date,
        MAX(comp.date_added) as last_component_date
    FROM categories c
    LEFT JOIN components comp ON c.category_id = comp.category_id
    WHERE 
        CASE 
            WHEN '{{ $json.params.search }}' != '' 
            THEN c.category_name ILIKE '%{{ $json.params.search }}%'
            ELSE TRUE
        END
    GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
),
paginated_data AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM filtered_categories
    ORDER BY 
        CASE WHEN '{{ $json.params.sortBy }}' = 'category_name' THEN category_name END ASC,
        CASE WHEN '{{ $json.params.sortBy }}' = 'component_count' THEN component_count END DESC,
        category_name ASC
    {{ $json.params.limit ? 'LIMIT ' + $json.params.limit : '' }}
    {{ $json.params.offset ? 'OFFSET ' + $json.params.offset : '' }}
)
SELECT 
    pd.*,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered_categories) as total_records
FROM paginated_data pd;
